outcome: Risk for pregnancy complications (postpartum hemorrhage, gestational diabetes, preeclampsia, and cesarean delivery)
Risk for individual severe morbidity diagnoses (stroke, embolism, eclampsia, and hysterectomy)
cohort: 36,944,292 women who delivered between 2006 and 2015 in the United States, identified using the Perspective database
finding: Women aged 45 years and older had the highest risk for a broad range of adverse outcomes during delivery hospitalizations.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was most common among women aged 45-54 years.
